patterns.note: Full-width content sections with generous vertical padding, often featuring centered text blocks for readability and impact.
A prominent, extremely large, uppercase sans-serif font is used for the hero brand name, creating a strong visual anchor, contrasted with a clean, readable sans-serif for headings and body text.
A high-contrast palette of dark greys/blacks and white is consistently used for text and surfaces, complemented by the natural, muted tones of the background imagery.

The hero section features a multi-layered parallax effect where the background image and the large brand text scroll at different, slower rates than the foreground content, creating a sense of depth. The top navigation bar shrinks and gains a solid background on scroll.
Clear, distinct content sections are introduced by large, bold headings, often accompanied by a descriptive sub-heading or paragraph, providing a structured flow of information.

technique_notes: The hero section employs a multi-layered parallax effect where the background image scrolls at a slower rate than the foreground text, creating depth. This effect is likely achieved using CSS keyframes or a JavaScript library that manipulates transform properties based on scroll position.
The main navigation bar at the top dynamically shrinks in height and changes its background from transparent to solid dark upon scrolling past the initial hero section.
After the hero, the page content scrolls over a fixed, full-bleed background image, giving the impression of content floating above a consistent visual foundation.

design_tokens.type_scale: A dramatic type scale with an extremely large, bold, uppercase hero text (~8x body), transitioning to clear, well-spaced headings and readable body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle, primarily seen on input fields and buttons, giving a soft, modern feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, with ample vertical spacing between sections and within text blocks, contributing to a sense of openness and clarity.

standout: The distinctive use of a dramatic, full-bleed mountain landscape as a dynamic background, first with a multi-layered parallax hero, then transitioning to a fixed backdrop for the entire page content. This creates a strong sense of depth and a unique visual identity that elevates the site beyond a standard corporate template.
